title: Antigravity approve-plan with a verified PO proof, and guard-push no longer reads a rev expression as a push
goal: (1) On the Antigravity runner the agent can run `pipeline-state.mjs approve-plan` when it carries the PO's valid signed design-approval proof, exactly as the common guard path already permits it, and is still refused without a proof, with a proof that does not verify, or with a proof bound to another commit/tree/intent. Today only `plugins/pipeline-core/hooks/antigravity-pretool-guard.mjs` refuses it unconditionally (`BLOCKED (PO Gate): Agent self-approval prohibited. 'approve-plan' is an explicit Human/PO decision.`, around lines 635-665), while `approve-push` may be run by the agent with `--proof`; the PO then needs two terminal commands for one design approval. Find how the shared guard (`plugins/pipeline-core/hooks/guard-devplan.mjs` and `lib/guard-devplan-policy.mjs`, tests `guard-devplan-design-approval*.test.mjs`) treats `approve-plan` with a proof on Claude and bring the Antigravity guard to the same decision by delegating to the shared logic rather than copying it (runner-neutral enforcement); (2) `guard-push` stops treating braces in a read-only revision expression such as `git rev-parse "HEAD^{tree}"` as shell expansion that makes a push target ambiguous: a read-only git subcommand never has a push target. Each part has a regression pin that is RED on the unchanged code. Work in your own clone `scratch/clones/k153` (`git clone --quiet . scratch/clones/k153` from the repository root). Deliver committed work in that clone plus `K153-protected.diff` / `K153-unprotected.diff` / `K153-msg-protected.txt` / `K153-msg-unprotected.txt` / `K153-notes.md` in the main checkout's `scratch/agent-out/` (message files end with the two trailer lines `AI-Assisted: true` and `Dispatch: stage-0 (elephant)` as their last paragraph; an empty diff may be omitted). The diffs must pass `git apply --check` in a second fresh clone `scratch/clones/k153-check`.
